g.text: This instruction is only applied to 1 unit of 0054 per machine located at Printing side
a) Bend the cladding edge at 45 degrees as shown in the drawing
b) Install it on the outer surface of Structure leg,
Facing to the furthest short edge of 0541_Table_V2
c) Make sure to press the 45 degrees edge against the Table bottom side
until you have a 90 degrees edge,
and then press along all the adhesive lines to the Structure leg
此说明仅适用于每台机器上位于打印侧的 1 个 0054 单元。
a) 如图所示，将覆层边缘弯折 45 度。
b) 将其安装在结构腿的外表面上，
c) 确保将 45 度边缘压紧在桌子底部，直至形成 90 度边缘，
然后沿着所有粘合线将其压紧到结构腿上。"

g.onmousemove: ShowToolTip(evt,'5',"0226_M4x8 Socket button head screw Black")
